info.title: PitchPilot Outreach API
info.description: Paid micro-utilities for cold-email outreach agents: domain deliverability audits, cold-email grading, template generation, plus a tools toolbox (hashing, JWT decode, IDs, slugs, JSON, regex, crypto prices, domain age, weather). Paid via x402 (USDC on Base).
info.x-guidance: PitchPilot Outreach API is a set of zero-account, pay-per-call x402 endpoints for cold-email outreach agents. Typical flow: (1) before sending, audit the sending domain with GET /deliverability?domain=example.com to confirm SPF, DKIM and DMARC are configured and get a ready-to-send / needs-fixes verdict; (2) draft the email, then score it with GET /grade?subject=...&body=... for a 12-point check (spam signals, length, personalization slots, CTA strength, deliverability risks) with concrete fixes; (3) if the draft is weak or you need a starting point, GET /template?persona=founder|agency|freelancer&offer=... generates a proven cold-email template. Tool endpoints: GET /tools/hash?text=... hashes a string (sha256/sha384/sha512, hex, base64, base64url, crc32); GET /tools/jwt-decode?token=... decodes a JWT with safety flags (never verifies signatures); GET /tools/uuid?count=5&version=v4|v7|ulid|nanoid returns crypto-secure IDs; GET /tools/slug?text=... slugifies unicode text; GET /tools/json?data=...&mode=flatten|csv flattens JSON or emits CSV; GET /tools/regex?pattern=...&text=... runs a regex with a backtracking-risk check; GET /tools/crypto-price?from=BTC&to=USD returns Coinbase spot/buy/sell; GET /tools/domain-age?domain=example.com returns RDAP registration date, age and registrar; GET /tools/weather?lat=52.52&lon=13.41 returns open-meteo current conditions + 3h forecast. Free (no payment) teasers: GET /score-preview?subject=... and GET /hash-preview?text=... (1000-char limit); GET /health returns liveness. All paid routes are authenticated by x402 payment (x402Version 2, scheme 'exact', USDC on Base Sepolia eip155:84532, facilitator https://x402.org/facilitator); call them without payment headers to receive a 402 challenge with payment instructions, complete it with your x402-capable wallet, and retry with the X-PAYMENT header.

get.summary: SPF/DKIM/DMARC deliverability audit for a sending domain
get.description: Returns SPF record (with +all and multiple-record fatals), DMARC policy, DKIM selector checks (google, selector1, k1) and a ready-to-send / needs-fixes / not-configured verdict.
Grades subject and body across 12 checks: spam signals, length, personalization slots, CTA strength, deliverability risks. Returns score, A-D grade, per-check details.

get.summary: Personalized cold email from proven templates
get.description: Generates subject + body from battle-tested templates for founder/agency/freelancer personas with sending cadence tips.

get.summary: SHA-256/384/512, hex, base64, base64url and CRC32 of a UTF-8 string
get.description: One-call hashing: WebCrypto SHA-256/384/512 over the utf-8 bytes, plus hex/base64/base64url of the input bytes and a CRC32 (IEEE) checksum. No length limit on the paid endpoint; a free 1000-char preview lives at /hash-preview.

get.summary: Decode a JWT header+payload with safety flags (never verifies the signature)
get.description: Splits a JWT, base64url-decodes header and payload, and reports flags: alg=none, weak alg (HS1/none), missing exp, expired exp. The signature is NEVER verified.

200.description: Decoded header, payload and safety flags

get.summary: Batch random IDs: UUIDv4, UUIDv7, ULID or nanoid
get.description: Returns 1-100 crypto-secure IDs (crypto.getRandomValues). v7 and ULID are time-ordered and sort chronologically.
NFKD-normalizes, strips latin diacritics, transliterates Cyrillic to ASCII, and warns when the result exceeds maxlength.

get.summary: Flatten JSON to dot paths or convert rows to CSV
get.description: flatten: dot-path -> leaf value map for any JSON. csv: array of objects (or arrays) to CSV text with RFC4180 quoting. Safe, explicit parse errors.

get.summary: Regex matches with groups, count and a backtracking-risk heuristic
get.description: Runs the pattern over text (always global) returning each match with index, capture groups and named groups, the total count, and a nested-quantifier backtracking-risk heuristic.

400.description: Invalid pattern, flags or text too long

get.summary: Coinbase spot/buy/sell price with spread percent
get.description: Fetches https://api.coinbase.com/v2/prices/{FROM}-{TO}/spot, /buy and /sell; returns all three plus the spread percent. Coinbase errors surface as a 502 with the upstream message.

get.summary: Domain registration date, age in days and registrar via RDAP
get.description: Tries https://rdap.org/domain/{domain} first, with an rdap.verisign.com fallback for .com/.net. A 404 verdicts as unregistered_or_no_rdap.
Fetches open-meteo current temperature, humidity, wind and weather_code, plus the next 3 hourly temperatures, with a full WMO weather_code description map.

get.summary: Free subject-line-only preview of the grader
get.description: Free (no payment) teaser: grades the subject line only - length, caps, spam-trigger words. The paid /grade endpoint scores the full email across 12 checks.

get.summary: Free hash preview (sha256 + crc32, first 1000 chars)
get.description: Free (no payment) teaser of /tools/hash: sha256 and crc32 of the first 1000 characters. The paid /tools/hash has no length limit and returns sha384/sha512/hex/base64/base64url too.

schema.description: UTF-8 text to hash (first 1000 chars used)
